description: Tell the story behind your numbers. KPI Story Cards combines small multiple charts, performance commentary, and business highlights in one Power BI visual. Give your audience a clear view of what changed and the context behind each result. Compare companies, business units, products, or regions using individual cards that bring trends and explanations together. KEY FEATURES • Small multiple cards: Present each company or category in its own card for easy comparison. • Performance trends: Display values across periods using column charts and data labels. • Change indicators: Highlight percentage changes between comparison periods. • Narrative commentary: Pair charts with concise explanations of performance. • Color-coded highlights: Distinguish positive developments, negative events, and neutral updates. IDEAL FOR • Executive dashboards and management reporting • Financial and portfolio performance reviews • Sales and operational KPI monitoring • Business unit, product, and regional comparisons Help your audience understand performance at a glance, with the numbers and their story side by side. All functionalities of this visual are available for free within Power BI Desktop. In Power BI Online Service, it will show a watermark.
